bloodCompensationAnchor.intent: 五甲和血剑在专属盾在线时产生额外实际减重，吸收插件重量；满充护盾补回血剑负HP项造成的常规可吸收承伤损失并留余量。
bloodCompensationAnchor.comparison: 同构筑、同插件，仅移除血剑基础负HP项的反事实；不替换成另一把有额外生命/防御的武器。
bloodCompensationAnchor.scope: 同强化标准构筑的标定锚点；不保证任意失衡强化/负HP插件、真伤、击溃、主动自损和未充满状态全部补偿。
bloodCompensationAnchor.universalShield: 盾按五甲实际HP贡献生成，不按损血或持血剑与否生成；血剑只是预算校准锚点。

confirmedBehavior.baseCycle: 手枪两槽成功发射返还一发合成成本，满盾按同成本补弹；基础循环守恒。
confirmedBehavior.p90: 显式武器固有效果每发额外3MP；套装外仍生效。
confirmedBehavior.healing: 所有护盾状态均允许MP治疗；治疗优先于充盾和补弹，可花到0。
confirmedBehavior.strength: 在线保持固定盾强；零容量时该层盾强归零。
confirmedBehavior.reboot: 满血初始化免费满盾，重初始化要求前后均满血；保留超血和MP。带伤初始化与战斗破盾继续付费渐充。
confirmedBehavior.laser: 171红束透明度18+82*火控进度；取消火控切枪日志，视觉与本发伤害读取同一进度。

pressureContract: Synthetic already-landed, post-mitigation damage; first hit at 6s. No inferred enemy attack or survival probability. All profiles start at zero shield.
limitations: No claim of parity with the strongest Sword Saint unarmed build or graduation acceptance.

Unmodified control panels exclude mods and neck. ConfiguredReference uses explicit selected mods/neck; neither panel includes grenades, consumables, other shields, allies, cancellation or positioning.
Boss TTK uses expected critical damage and prior contact counts; lazy dodge, counters and target shields are excluded.
Unarmed animation events are authored XFL candidates, not measured hits; no automatic winner from equal-contact assumptions.
Gun/dual-pistol reload and switching schedules are explicit approximations, not an executable AS2 replay.
Reserve magazines are assumed available; normal reload rounds are counted separately from synthesized rounds. No claim about finite inventory endurance or gold cost.
